personas.persona_name_label: Woman eligible for cervical cancer screening
personas.role_and_context: A woman in the target screening population who may attend facility-based or community-based screening, receive triage, treatment, and follow-up, or self-collect a sample where offered.
personas.clinical_competencies: Understands screening purpose and follow-up instructions as provided by the service.
personas.goals: Get screened; understand results; receive timely treatment or referral; avoid loss to follow-up.
personas.key_tasks: Attend screening; provide consent and history; self-collect sample if offered; return for follow-up.
personas.pain_points_barriers: Risk of loss to follow-up; possible stigma or misunderstanding of HPV results; access barriers for disability or postpartum/pregnancy contexts.
personas.information_needs: Screening schedule; meaning of HPV/VIA/cytology results; treatment and follow-up instructions; referral instructions.
personas.language_accessibility_needs: May need clear communication and accessibility support; sign language interpreter may be needed for deaf women.
personas.privacy_and_safeguarding_considerations: Partner involvement should be encouraged carefully to avoid misinterpretation and gender-based violence concerns.
personas.notes: Derived from client-facing guidance and disability/partner-involvement notes.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Self-collected samples provide women with a sample-collection kit and usage instructions

_derivation.explanation: Derived from client-facing screening, self-collection, and follow-up guidance.

personas.role_and_context: A trained nurse who performs screening, sample collection, VIA, and some treatment tasks where authorized.
personas.clinical_competencies: Trained in cervical cancer screening; trained in cryotherapy where applicable; able to perform VIA and collect samples.
personas.goals: Provide efficient screening and treatment; minimize loss to follow-up; document findings accurately.
personas.key_tasks: Collect samples; perform VIA; support triage; perform cryotherapy if trained; document findings; refer suspicious cancer.
personas.pain_points_barriers: Need for training, supervision, quality assurance, and access to equipment/reagents.
personas.information_needs: Eligibility criteria; screening algorithms; treatment eligibility; referral criteria; documentation requirements.
personas.privacy_and_safeguarding_considerations: Must communicate clearly and support partner involvement without increasing GBV risk.
personas.notes: Derived from VIA, cryotherapy, and screening-level guidance.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: It requires training and supervision of primary care providers

_derivation.explanation: Derived from provider training, VIA performance, and cryotherapy guidance.

personas.key_tasks: Collect samples; perform screening; support referral and documentation.

personas.information_needs: Screening method selection; triage and referral criteria; follow-up intervals.

personas.role_and_context: A gynecologist who performs or supports excisional procedures, cone biopsy, and management of complex lesions.
personas.clinical_competencies: Trained in LEEP and cone biopsy; able to recognize and manage complications.
personas.goals: Treat lesions appropriately and manage complex or advanced disease.
personas.key_tasks: Perform cone biopsy; support LEEP referral and management; manage complications.
personas.pain_points_barriers: Need for equipment, anesthesia, and surgical facility readiness.
personas.information_needs: Eligibility for ablation vs excision; pathology and margin status; referral criteria.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: It is usually done under general or regional anesthesia by gynecologists and gynecologic oncologists trained in the procedure

_derivation.explanation: Derived from cone biopsy and LEEP guidance.

personas.role_and_context: A specialist who receives immediate referrals for suspected cancer and manages diagnosis and treatment.
personas.goals: Confirm diagnosis and provide definitive treatment.
personas.key_tasks: Receive referrals; diagnose; treat; coordinate further management.
personas.pain_points_barriers: Delayed referral or incomplete diagnostic workup.
personas.information_needs: Referral details; screening results; biopsy findings; prior treatment history.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: immediately referred to a gynecologic oncologist for diagnosis and treatment

_derivation.explanation: Derived from referral and cancer management guidance.

personas.key_tasks: Process samples; interpret microscopy; classify abnormalities.
personas.pain_points_barriers: Need for skilled personnel and logistics.
personas.information_needs: Specimen labeling; cytology workflow; reporting standards.

_provenance.evidence_excerpt: Cytotechnologists in the laboratory process and interpret it.

personas.information_needs: Appointment timing; referral status; service integration points.
